description: Writes the Reclaim example app (reclaimprotocol/builder-example: a Fastify backend and a Vite frontend that create sessions, verify callbacks, and render every verification state) into `projectDir`, and sets its backend to the latest `@reclaimprotocol/client`. It picks a free backend port (3000, else the next free one, written to `packages/backend/.env`). Use it when the workspace has no app yet, with the workspace root you were started in as `projectDir`; don't clone the repository yourself. Refuses when a file it would write already exists with different content. Returns the commit, file count, client version, `backendPort`, and next steps.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the workspace root you were started in.

name: create_example_app
